Name: Conivaptan
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: Dual vasopressin receptor antagonist; induces free-water excretion (aquaresis) for euvolemic/hypervolemic hyponatremia.

Name: Lumacaftor
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: CFTR corrector; used in combination (Orkambi) to improve lung function and reduce exacerbations in Cystic Fibrosis.

Name: Entrectinib
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: Multi-kinase inhibitor; suppresses survival and proliferation pathways to trigger tumor apoptosis in NTRK/ROS1+ cancers.

Name: Nilotinib
Primary Targets: Tyrosine-protein kinase ABL1, c-Kit, PDGF receptor
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: Signal transduction inhibitor; targets aberrant BCR-ABL signaling to treat Chronic Myeloid Leukemia (CML).

Name: Rimegepant
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: CGRP receptor antagonist; rapidly blocks pronociceptive migraine pathways to abort acute migraine attacks.

Name: Dutasteride
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: Selective 5α-reductase inhibitor; reduces circulating DHT levels to shrink the prostate and manage BPH symptoms.

Name: Lomitapide
Primary Targets: Microsomal triglyceride transfer protein (MTP) large subunit
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: MTP inhibitor; directly prevents assembly of ApoB-containing lipoproteins to treat severe hypercholesterolemia.

Name: Eltrombopag
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: Thrombopoietin receptor agonist; stimulates megakaryocyte proliferation to increase platelet production.

Name: Alatrofloxacin
Primary Targets: Bacterial DNA Topoisomerase IV / DNA Gyrase
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: Fluoroquinolone prodrug antibiotic; disrupts bacterial replication pathways.

Name: Midostaurin
Clinical Indication & Mechanism: Multi-kinase inhibitor; blocks constitutive aberrant signaling cascades to treat AML and systemic mastocytosis (ASM).
